notes.title: Cats Around Us: Black Cat is out now!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]The moment we’ve all been waiting for is finally here![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][i]Cats Around Us: Black Cat[/i] is out now! Yay!! 😺🎉

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/76e016922707fffb1cf49270814fca19a62bd865.png"][/img][/h2][p]Huge thanks to all of you who’ve wishlisted and bought the game, your support means the world and keeps us creating!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426090/Cats_Around_Us_Black_Cat/"][/dynamiclink]Special shoutout to [url="https://www.instagram.com/apitnobaka/"]Apit No Baka[/url] for teaming up with us to craft this captivating silent comic, to [url="https://www.facebook.com/dimasnovandel"]Dimas Novan Delfiano[/url] for helping spark awesome story ideas, and to [url="https://x.com/MijilSatria"]Mijil Pamungkas[/url] for the amazing music that always vibes with Noobzilla’s work![/p][p][/p][p]And a massive thank you to our incredible community for coming together to translate the game into so many languages!! thanks to these awesome folks:
[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p]NVK1[/p][p]osy[/p][p]Viktor[/p][p]Megisa[/p][p]Nainula[/p][p]anwime[/p][p]Zerathos[/p][p]Derwyen[/p][p]Sombedoy[/p][p]ChiiDan[/p][p]F. Ried[/p][p]Ruubyy[/p][p]monlum58[/p][p]Violencia Kurayami[/p][p]DerNeik[/p][p]boo[/p][p]Nicoli4[/p][/td][td][p]Paapurup[/p][p]Wendyshikii[/p][p]Lunastrina[/p][p]Riskrunner[/p][p]JulJuicy[/p][p]Max_mw[/p][p]emofedora[/p][p]Pinguin[/p][p]Bisqts[/p][p]Cirică Eric-Cristian[/p][p]Yauheni "Merci Beaucoup" Krupen[/p][p]Igor "Vikindor" Levitin[/p][p]Yang Yuanyuan[/p][p]bluecaffeine[/p][p]ivanka[/p][p]iclownic[/p][p]Kyuu[/p][/td][td][p]Kanchide[/p][p]Torik[/p][p]JulJuicy[/p][p]Яemi[/p][p]Riskrunner[/p][p]Flafi[/p][p]agusfortuny[/p][p]SheyCroix[/p][p]Shaegard[/p][p]Flafi[/p][p]Kinshred[/p][p]Ancsur2002[/p][p]Nainula[/p][p]Alien[/p][p]nhtlnh[/p][p]air_fago[/p][p]Dachs Corgi[/p][p]DiCaver[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
Big thanks for all your help! If any names are missing or misspelled, just hit me up! :D

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

That’s our happy news for you![/p][p]Have a blast playing and enjoying the simple story in the game! ^^[/p][p][/p][p]If you run into any issues or bugs, don’t hesitate to let us know on our forum: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3426090/discussions/0/595159519773939452/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3426090/discussions/0/595159519773939452/[/url][/p][p]

Warm wishes, and may your day be filled with joy! 💚[/p][p]

UB & Estu

notes.title: [Demo] Level progress is now saved!
notes.content:
We've added level progress saving! Now, if you return to a level you’ve worked on but haven’t finished, it’ll pick up where you left off.

Applies to normal and sepia modes, but not timer mode yet.


Cheers,

notes.title: May Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/2b9aabf3e3c8c4afbf03ed957467313be90b2f3c.png[/img]

Hi friends!

Can you believe we’re already in the third week of May? How’s everyone doing?
We hope you’re all doing great! :D And if things are a bit rough right now, we really hope everything gets better soon and that happiness finds its way back to you 💖

We’ve got a few updates we’d love to share with you! :D

First up, the demo for Cats Around Us is now available! ^^
It’s a short demo (because the game is short too XD), so feel free to give it a try! And if you haven’t wishlisted it yet, now’s the perfect time to hit that wishlist button :D

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426090/Cats_Around_Us_Black_Cat/

---

Second, it's been 25 days since Cats and Seek: Tokyo launched!
It’s already been played by over 8,000 players and has gotten 100+ reviews with a Very Positive rating! Thank you so, so much for all the love and support 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925320/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo/

---

And last but not least, we gave our Noobzilla logo a little makeover!
We think it looks much cuter and more adorable now ^^ Hope you like it too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/f2d6b2139dfd84a99bb6cbe276ad1abd5f496352.png[/img]



That’s all for now!
Thanks a bunch for taking the time to read this little update :D
Warm hugs and have a lovely day!



– UB & Estu

P.S. Don’t forget to wishlist Pictective too, pretty please ^^ Thank you! 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690390/Pictective/

notes.title: Cats and Seek: Tokyo is out now!
notes.content:
Hello friends, the day we've all been waiting for is finally here 

[h1][b]🎉 Cats and Seek: Tokyo is out now! 🎉[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925320/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo/

Thank you so much for all your support and wishlists! Thanks to you, Cats and Seek: Tokyo made it into the [b]Popular Upcoming[/b] list on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/959310ac0c5b6628a046a36a89f1039569eab926.png[/img]

Just like the previous titles in the series, Cats and Seek: Tokyo is free to play with[b] 1 level [/b]where you can search for[b] 105 hidden cats[/b]. And yes, you can unlock all achievements in this free level!

If you're craving more cat-finding fun, there's also a DLC with 4 extra levels and 420 more cats waiting for you. Hopefully, it satisfies your cat-collecting cravings! ^^


[h2]So, what’s new in Cats and Seek: Tokyo?[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve added a brand-new feature called Rubber Stamp Collection, inspired by Eki stamps often found at Japanese train stations and tourist spots — a fun way to collect memories through stamps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/433fb5fd92b095a8d07e6624b37464fb4068f00f.png[/img]
[*] And a huge thank-you to our amazing community translators! because of your help, the cat descriptions in Cats and Seek: Tokyo are now available in 18 languages! We received over 120 volunteer sign-ups (so sorry we couldn’t include everyone XD some languages were completed really fast!)
[/list]

Because the list is quite long, let me know if I accidentally missed your name  ^^. We’re truly grateful for all your help, and we’re sorry that our workflow isn’t fully optimized yet to make the translation process easier for you.

[quote]Since this was a community effort by fellow Cats and Seek players, we hope you’ll be understanding if you come across small translation hiccups. But if you notice a major issue, feel free to DM me![/quote]


-------------------

[h3]Cats and Seek: Tokyo marks the end of our Japan trilogy.[/h3]

We’re incredibly grateful we were able to complete it. This whole series is a love letter to our first-ever trip to Japan in 2019. It’s been 6 years, but it still feels like yesterday: enjoying takoyaki in Osaka, exploring Kyoto’s temples, and gazing at the bright LED lights of Tokyo. Fun fact: the cities we visited are in the exact same order as the game releases: Osaka, Kyoto, then Tokyo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2672090/Cats_and_Seek_Osaka/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2845320/Cats_and_Seek_Kyoto/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925320/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo/

We hope these games sparks some nostalgia if you’ve been to Japan before, and if you haven’t, we truly hope you’ll get the chance to go someday. 

And to everyone in Japan, thank you so much for your warmth and kindness during our time there. We really hope we can visit you again soon! ❤️

-------------------

[h3]So, what’s next for the Cats and Seek series?[/h3]

We’re not stopping! Estu already has a new idea for the next game, and we’ll be sharing more soon. If you have a theme you’d love to see in a future Cats and Seek game, feel free to drop your idea in the comments :D you might just inspire us!

If you run into any bugs or issues, please report them in the forum here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2925320/discussions/0/597399045152003671/
We’ll do our best to fix them as soon as possible!

That’s all from us for now. Thank you again for all the support, we hope you have a relaxing and cozy time with Cats and Seek: Tokyo. Happy cat-hunting! 

With love ❤️,


UB & Estu
